wiki.title: Guy Ward
wiki.extract: Guy Ward is an American politician from West Virginia. He is a Republican and represented District 74 in the West Virginia House of Delegates from December 1, 2020 to December 1, 2022. In May 2022, he was defeated in the primary by Mike DeVault. He was appointed to the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 74 to replace Mike DeVault on January 28, 2026.
